name: Article 5, § 1, point a – 135
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (a) contribute to the development of measures, to enhance civil-military preparedness and coordination of response to disasters and crises within the Union, in cooperation with the Member States, by strengthening cooperation between civil and military authorities including through the development of a civilian and-military preparedness framework at Union level in support of civil protection objectives;
